statement: N-0078 SEO and listing quality. Question: which checks count as a listing problem? Candidate checks (Warren picks): title contains brand + model; at least N images; description present and over N words; key specs present (CPU, RAM, storage, screen); price shown and in stock; search position of our listing for named search terms on Takealot. Evidence: listing_observation keeps the raw page snapshot (spec section 8), so content checks can be re-run without re-fetching; search position needs a new fetch of the search page per term. Impact: content checks are cheap; search position adds polling load per term. Reversibility: high. Resolving step: Warren lists the checks and the search terms.
